purpose: Current-audit supplement for the region/skill browser. These rows fill missing skills, replace archive links with current Wiki or direct Jagex sources where possible, and deliberately leave optimizer-grade rates blank when the underlying guide is stale or the League resource loop is unresolved.
rules: Rates are base-game rates before Equilibrium XP multipliers unless explicitly stated otherwise.
No-trading changes resource practicality even when the training action itself is global.
A current method with an outdated combat XP table is kept as a candidate with no trusted rate, not silently treated as optimizer-grade.
Portable stations, Treasure Hunter items, DXP assumptions and deprecated auras are not assumed to exist in Equilibrium.

methods.notes: Train through the highest practical region-available monsters or Slayer tasks while using current post-modernisation Melee abilities.
methods.warning: The current members melee training guide explicitly says its combat XP recommendations need major updating after the 2023 combat XP changes. Do not attach an optimizer-grade XP/h rate yet.

methods.notes: Shares Melee combat training access with Attack; region choice changes available Slayer masters, monster density and gear progression.
methods.warning: The current members melee training guide explicitly says its combat XP recommendations need major updating after the 2023 combat XP changes.

methods.method: Combat training with Defence XP enabled
methods.notes: Defence can be trained through the available combat styles by changing combat XP allocation. Region value follows the chosen combat route rather than one fixed training location.
methods.warning: Legacy combat training XP/h tables are not trusted for Equilibrium planning.

methods.method: Passive combat XP while training a combat style
methods.notes: Constitution XP is earned alongside combat training. Planner value therefore follows the selected combat route and region rather than a unique Constitution method.
methods.warning: Do not import old ED3/Abyss-era XP claims as current rates without a 2026 benchmark.

methods.notes: Use current post-modernisation Ranged abilities and region-available ammunition/gear. The Abyss remains a possible Forinthry AFK route, but its old published XP figures are not optimizer-grade.
methods.warning: The current Ranged training guide says it needs substantial updating after the 2023 combat XP changes.

methods.notes: Use current post-modernisation Magic abilities and region-available spellbook/resource access. The Abyss is a possible Forinthry AFK route, but old XP figures are not used as a current benchmark.
methods.warning: Combat training guide tables predate the current XP and 2026 combat model; benchmark after League launch before ranking routes numerically.

methods.notes: The Wiki describes Fishing Frenzy as capable of the highest Fishing XP/hour in the game; the listed level-99 base rate is about 285k XP/h. Deep Sea Fishing Hub is an official Kandarin Equilibrium example.
Lower XP than Fishing Frenzy but produces sailfish, which matters more in a no-trading League than a pure XP ranking suggests.

methods.xp_rate: comparable to shark or better; exact no-trading League throughput depends on pie supply
methods.notes: Bake Pie never burns pies and also gives Magic XP. Fremennik matters because the route depends on Lunar magic unless Equilibrium separately grants the spell globally.
The current guide calls out Neitiznot because the yak pen has nearby supply, a range and a bank. In a no-trading League that local loop is more useful than its main-game popularity suggests.

methods.location: Anachronia Dinosaur Farm / 'Accidental' Fletching and Firemaking
methods.intensity: AFK up to roughly 3 minutes per batch
methods.notes: Igniting sharp shell shards gives 341.9 base XP every five ticks and the current guide reports about 410k base XP/h. The activity is on Anachronia.
The current guide's line-fire table assumes roughly 1,200 logs/hour. Resource access is the League constraint, not the tile where they are burned.
The 20 July 2026 Mid-Game Rebalance retiered core Fletching and lists primal arrows at 900k XP/h in the high-end XP table.
The 20 July 2026 Mid-Game Rebalance lists primal bolts at 975k XP/h. Primal bolts are tier-100 ammunition made from eternal magic headless shafts and primal bolt tips.
The current Wiki gives about 11.7m base XP/h for the portable-deposit-box version, with slower fallback methods around 4.62m and 3.72m base XP/h.
methods.warning: Do not assume portable deposit boxes exist in Equilibrium. The 11.7m rate is a main-game ceiling, not a League guarantee. Taverley is in Asgarnia.

methods.level_range: all pouch tiers as materials allow
methods.notes: Starting-region Summoning option. The obelisks build a material-saving / XP-rate buff and have a nearby bank, making this route worth tracking even if it is slower than the main-game Taverley speed method.

Amlodd is one of the closest bank-to-obelisk routes and offers efficient shard returns. The main-game 20% Voice of Seren bonus should be treated as an environment-specific bonus rather than assumed League baseline.
The current guide lists Menaphos among the closest bank-to-obelisk routes, giving Desert a practical Summoning route without relying on Asgarnia or Tirannwn.

methods.warning: Demonic Skull was removed in the same July 20 update. Do not use old boosted Wilderness-course rates.

methods.xp_event: A tier-3 structure reinforced with 65 Eternal Magic Frames and 6 Stone Wall Segments awards 499,200 base XP after the July 20 rebalance.
methods.intensity: long AFK windows; active hotspots improve rate
methods.region_warning: Catalyst grouped Fort Forinthry under Misthalin. Use that as the working League region until Equilibrium publishes its own finer locality mapping.
